```{r}
.libPaths(.Library)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(splatter)
    library(stringr)
    library(dplyr)
    library(SPARSim)
})
```



```{r}
dparams = expand.grid(
    batch.facLoc = c(seq(0.1, 1, 0.1)), # Strength of batch effect
    de.facLoc    = c(seq(0.1, 1, 0.1)), # Biological variability
    nbatch       = c(2,3,4,5,10), # Number of batches
    ngroup       = c(2,4,6,8), # Number of cell types
    groupCells   = 1000, # Number of cells per cell type (adjust as needed)
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
names(dparams)

outdir <- "/local/Projects/AAkalin_Neuroblastoma/Results/simulate_single_cell/h5ad"
samplesheet <- dparams %>%
    mutate(sample_name = across(everything(), ~paste0(cur_column(), .x))) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(sample_name = paste(sample_name, collapse = "_")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(original_h5ad = file.path(outdir, paste0(sample_name, ".h5ad"))) %>%
    select(sample_name, original_h5ad, everything())
colnames(samplesheet)


```

```{r}
create_and_save_sim <- function(sample_name, ngroup, nbatch, groupCells, batch.facLoc, de.facLoc, outfile){

    if (!file.exists(outfile)) {
        print(paste0("Processing ", sample_name, " with params:"))
        print(knitr::kable(cbind(ngroup, batch.facLoc, de.facLoc)))
        set.seed(42)
        message("Simulating data")

        sim = splatSimulate(
            batchCells = rep(groupCells * ngroup, nbatch),
            group.prob = rep(1/ngroup, ngroup),
            batch.facLoc = batch.facLoc,
            batch.facScale = 0.1,
            method = "groups",
            verbose = FALSE,
            out.prob    = 0.001,
            de.prob     = 0.1,
            de.facLoc   = de.facLoc,
            de.facScale = 0.1,
            bcv.common  = 0.1
        )

        counts <- t(counts(sim)) %>% as.matrix() # for AnnData the matrix is transposed: Gene in columns Cells in rows
        metadata <- colData(sim) %>% as.data.frame()
        var <- rowData(sim) %>% as.data.frame()

        message("Creating AnnData object")
        adata <- anndataR::AnnData(
                            X = counts,
                            obs = metadata,
                            var = var
                        )
        message(paste0("Saving ", outfile))
        anndataR::write_h5ad(adata, path = outfile, mode = "w", compression = "none")
    } else {
        message(paste0(outfile, " already exists. Skipping..."))
    }
}
```

```{r}
library(doMC)
registerDoMC(25)
foreach(i = 1:nrow(samplesheet))%dopar%{
    set.seed(42)
    dparam = samplesheet[i,]
    create_and_save_sim(dparam$sample_name, dparam$ngroup, dparam$nbatch, dparam$groupCells, dparam$batch.facLoc, dparam$de.facLoc, dparam$original_h5ad)    
}
```
